title: Finding (backend -> frontend)
description: v1.1 adds mapping, mapping_version, evidence_roles, token_relation and stage 'lure_access'. technique_ids stays and always equals the non-null technique_id values in mapping.

rule_id.description: R11 and R12 are v1.2 (contracts/API.md, Cases and rules (v1.2))

rule_version.description: e.g. R01@1. Bumped whenever matching or mapping changes; old findings keep the version that produced them.

incident_id.description: The case (or investigation) this finding belongs to. Name kept for v1.0 compatibility.

mapping.description: v1.1. One entry per ATT&CK interpretation, with why. technique_id may be null when a behaviour is worth showing but no technique fits honestly.

status.description: attempted = input aimed at the behaviour; emulated = the decoy played along (fake result); observed = an independent result record shows it happened in the lab.

mapping_version.description: v1.1. Version of the technique catalogue used, e.g. 'map@2'.

stage.description: Observed stage in the local progression model, not a claim of a complete kill chain. v1.1 adds lure_access (a synthetic lure was fetched over the web).

label.description: Plain words, e.g. 'Repeated SSH password guessing (5 failures in 60 s)'

limitation.description: What this does not prove, e.g. 'Does not show the account was compromised'

evidence_roles.description: v1.1. event_id -> request | result | bait | presentation. Lets the UI show which record is the input and which is the decoy's answer.

points.description: Points this finding contributes now. 0 if its rule already counted or it waits for confirmation.

pending_confirmation.description: True for R09 until the analyst confirms the link

token_relation.description: v1.1, R09 only. linked = a bait_served result record for this token exists in the same run and a strong_candidate link cites it. request_only = only a bait-read command (requested_asset_id) was seen; a weaker candidate link cites it. orphan = no serving or request was found; visible, never scored, no link invented.

attribution.description: v1.1, R09 only. ambiguous = several issuances of the same static credential were eligible, so the backend does not claim which one was reused.
